ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a topographic profile along the Tropic, with sea area e on the left. After the profile enters land, a high mountain range b appears near about 70°, and to the right it passes through inland terrain near 60° and 50°, with sea area f at the far right. Then reason: Combining “along the Tropic” with the longitude distribution of 70°, 60°, and 50° in the figure, as well as the high mountain range near 70°, it can be judged that this is a topographic profile of South America near the Tropic of Capricorn. The high mountain range is the Andes Mountains, and sea area e on the left is the Pacific sea area on the west coast of South America. The ocean current flowing along the west coast of South America is the Peru Cold Current, which flows along the coast toward the equator, so its flow direction characteristic is from high latitudes to low latitudes.

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：剖面从左侧e海域进入陆地，70°附近出现高大山脉b，向东到60°、50°为内陆高原/山地，再到右侧f海域。结合题干“沿回归线”和经度70°W—50°W，可定位为南美洲沿南回归线的地形剖面，e为太平洋南美西岸海域。再根据地理常识，南美西岸流经的是秘鲁寒流，其流向是沿岸向赤道方向流，因此特征为由高纬流向低纬。
